exit_band_stop.long: exit when close < max(ref_hi*(1 + s*sigma), VWAP - y*sigma_vw)
exit_band_stop.short: exit when close > min(ref_lo*(1 - s*sigma), VWAP + y*sigma_vw)
exit_band_stop.y_sign: positive -> VWAP leg BELOW price for a long (looser/more room); user-selected over the literal negative-y version which was rejected on both markets
exit_band_stop.sigma_vw: per-bar causal cumulative volume-weighted std of typical price about VWAP (core.vol_bands.vwap_sigma_bands definition)
exit_band_stop.entries: unchanged, multiplier-1.0 noise band + VWAP gate

null_policy: run Null C only for a market whose real grid clears dSharpe>=+0.10 and netR>=baseline
primary_metric: max-cell zero-trade-day daily net-ATR-R Sharpe uplift over the both stop
kill_test: reject if NQ max-cell Sharpe uplift < +0.10, or (if real gate passes) Null C family-max upper-tail p > 0.05
